label: Kinetic typography / text cinetic
description: Staggered word reveals with a moving underline and a quiet reading hold. Text cinetic cu intrare pe cuvinte, accent și pauză de lectură.
whenToUse: A short supplied hook or chapter heading whose wording is the subject.
avoid: Long captions, invented claims or using this heading as a substitute for an illustrative scene.

parameters.description: One to three short supplied words; change SVG line positions for more copy.
Delay between words, as a fraction of scene progress; keep the last reveal before 0.40.

choreography.action: 0.32–0.48: accent settles on the final word.
choreography.exit: 0.90–1: underline contracts; words stay visible for a cut.

adaptation: Replace sample words with exact user copy; do not invent narration cues.
Match the underline direction/color to the next shot. Avoid an additional timeline fade over its reveal.

label: Image shutter reveal / dezvăluire imagine
description: An approved image revealed by opposing shutters, an independent focus frame and a restrained push-in. Dezvăluire de fotografie cu mască și ramă animată.
whenToUse: Introduce a supplied portrait, product image or document with a deliberate visual reveal.
avoid: No approved image is available, or the brief prohibits animated image treatment.

parameters.description: Short exact supplied label; empty string removes it.
Image scale change; use 0–0.08 and preserve meaningful image edges.

requiredImages.role: Approved primary subject image; preserve aspect ratio.

choreography.reveal: 0–0.30: opposing shutters open across the image.
choreography.action: 0.15–0.62: image push and focus-frame expansion move independently.
choreography.exit: 0.92–1: focus line retracts; image stays visible.

adaptation: Attach the actual approved project filename as image_1; images.image_1 is supplied by the host, never a filename/URL.
Change meet/slice only after considering whether cropping hides the subject.
The sample label is not required copy and the supplied raster is not a 3D reconstruction.

label: Layered parallax / straturi independente
description: Different camera-relative motion for an approved background and separate transparent foreground, with independent orbit markers. Parallax pe straturi reale, nu zoom pe o singură fotografie.
whenToUse: There are two genuinely separate approved artwork layers and depth helps direct attention.
avoid: Only one flat image is available; do not claim to reconstruct hidden geometry or invent a cutout.

parameters.description: Foreground horizontal travel in SVG units, 0–45; background moves at a smaller opposing rate.
Short exact supplied title, or empty string.

requiredImages.role: Approved separate foreground with transparent alpha, not a second opaque copy.

choreography.reveal: 0–0.20: foreground settles while background is already visible.
choreography.action: 0.20–0.72: separate layers travel at different rates; markers trace independent paths.
choreography.hold: 0.72–0.94: camera/layers settle with the subject visible.
choreography.exit: 0.94–1: composition holds for a matching cut; no extra fade.

adaptation: Attach both actual project images only after source-use approval; never silently generate a missing layer.
Preserve foreground alpha and test layer coverage throughout travel.
This is 2D layered depth, not genuine SceneThree or inferred 3D geometry.

label: Glitch handoff / tranziție glitch
description: A single restrained strip-displacement pulse hands off between two supplied text states. Tranziție internă glitch fără stroboscop, revenită la o imagine stabilă.
whenToUse: A brief explicitly calls for a digital interruption or state change within one scene.
avoid: Quiet documentary/minimal briefs, sustained flashing, or pretending this is a recipe transition between clips.

parameters.description: Displacement in SVG units, 0–28; no repeating flash cycle.
Strip CSS color; keep background luminance stable.

choreography.action: 0.32–0.62: one displacement envelope; state switches at 0.48.
choreography.hold: 0.62–0.94: incoming state is stable and readable.
choreography.exit: 0.94–1: retain incoming state for a clean cut.

adaptation: Use an actual supported recipe transition with real clip overlap for a junction between separate clips; this component is an internal handoff only.
Never add rapid full-frame flashes or increase frequency to imply more impact.
If retiming to speech, use measured cues rather than guessing word times.

label: Animated process / diagramă animată
description: Three named stages activate sequentially as a signal traverses connecting paths, followed by a complete reading hold. Diagramă de proces cu noduri și conexiuni animate independent.
whenToUse: Explain a supplied three-step sequence or information flow without inventing factual values.
avoid: A process is not actually sequential, or more stages require redesigning the layout.

parameters.description: Exactly three short supplied stage names; fit each within its node.
Exact supplied process title, or empty string.

choreography.action: 0.22–0.70: links draw and a signal moves from source through processing to result.
choreography.hold: 0.70–0.94: all nodes and links remain legible.
choreography.exit: 0.94–1: complete state holds; use a matching next-shot line or cut.

adaptation: Use the real process and its supplied labels; the demo is not evidence of a real system.
Move nodes/paths together when changing layout; one shared SVG coordinate system prevents drift.
Keep an explanation scene, not a heading-only substitute; preserve node activation and path motion during repairs.

label: Exploded lens assembly / reveal 3D
description: Genuine SceneThree schematic lens assembly: separate barrel rings and glass elements converge along an optical axis as a lit camera view settles. Reveal 3D cu geometrie, lumini și cameră reale.
whenToUse: A schematic optical assembly or layered product reveal benefits from depth and independently moving parts.
avoid: Claiming the schematic is a verified physical product teardown; arbitrary unrelated subjects with unchanged lens geometry.

parameters.description: Initial extra separation along the optical axis, 0–1.5 world units.
Exact supplied DOM label, or empty string.

choreography.reveal: 0–0.18: separated physical parts are framed and lit.
choreography.action: 0.18–0.70: parts converge independently along the axis while the camera makes a short arc.
choreography.hold: 0.70–0.94: assembled silhouette and lit glass hold in a three-quarter view.
choreography.exit: 0.94–1: maintain the subject for a matching cut; no automatic fade.

adaptation: Use visualMode=3d and preserve actual SceneThree geometry/lights/update(frame), not CSS perspective.
Replace the schematic geometry when the subject is not a lens; do not merely rename the title.
Every update sets complete positions/rotations/camera from frame.progress; never accumulate deltas or start another render loop.
Frame the object for portrait as well as landscape; keep overlays above the caption band.

label: Swiss grid motion / grilă tipografică
description: Precision Swiss motion: independently wiped modular bars align, then a single signal tile breaks the grid. No bounce, gradients or generic title-only reveal.
whenToUse: A graphic identity or design-system beat where alignment, rhythm and a single exception are the subject.
avoid: Replacing a documentary subject or requested illustration with unrelated abstract bars.

parameters.description: Short supplied heading; the sample is technique-demo copy, not narration.
Flat paper color; preserve contrast with black modules.

choreography.reveal: 0–0.44: title clip-reveal and five staggered bar wipes.
choreography.action: 0.45–0.68: only the signal tile departs from alignment.
choreography.exit: 0.90–1: bottom signal rule grows to motivate a matching cut.

adaptation: Read film-styles/swiss-motion for visual grammar; this native component does not execute upstream code.
Replace the actual artifact/modules when the subject is not a design system; do not only rename the title.
Retain one signal color, precise non-bouncing motion and existing separate captions.

label: Blueprint mechanism / mecanism în mișcare
description: A cyanotype-style crank, connecting rod and slider convert rotation to translation; independent flow markers trace an outlet before a stable hold. A schematic, not measured engineering evidence.
whenToUse: Explain schematic mechanical conversion or an approved supplied mechanism with adapted geometry.
avoid: Claiming verified pump dynamics, dimensions or using unchanged machinery for an unrelated topic.

parameters.description: Crank throw in SVG units, 40–68; the rod length remains 190.
Complete turns before settling, 1–3; retime to measured cues.

choreography.reveal: 0–0.30: engineering lines draw; piston and linkage appear.
choreography.action: 0.26–0.76: crank drives the rod and piston with geometric constraints; outlet markers move separately.
choreography.hold: 0.80–0.94: mechanism is still, complete and readable.
choreography.exit: 0.94–1: retain the schematic for a justified cut or matching next-shot line.

adaptation: Read film-styles/blueprint; no external CAD or empirical values are bundled.
Edit the actual linkage/path and labels for the real process; a new name is not a new subject.
Keep all positions absolute functions of progress so backward seeks reproduce the same frame.

label: Paper stage 3D / carte care prinde volum
description: Genuine SceneThree paper-book stage: two page leaves unfold, three roof/facade panels rise on independent hinges, warm/cool lights and a camera arc settle on a visible miniature street.
whenToUse: A paper architecture/pop-up scene where folding and spatial staging carry the narrative.
avoid: Pretending simple house panels are a realistic place, or substituting them for complex characters/approved artwork.

parameters.description: Three facade colors; preserve the page/material contrast.
Short supplied label, or empty to remove it.

choreography.reveal: 0–0.24: page leaves rotate around the book spine.
choreography.action: 0.25–0.65: three independent paper panels rise; camera arcs until 0.74.
choreography.hold: 0.74–0.94: open book and all facades remain visible with stable lighting.
choreography.exit: 0.94–1: retain open stage; match the next shot's paper palette or cut.

adaptation: Read film-styles/paper-popup or paper-lantern for direction; this native example is not an upstream film copy.
Use genuine SceneThree geometry/lighting, not CSS perspective. Change the panels/artwork to explain the subject.
Use approved image attachments for detailed illustrations instead of inventing fragile shape-stack characters; preserve no-generation choices.

label: Aligned before/after comparison
description: Two approved aligned states share one frame while an independent comparison boundary exposes the change, then both remain readable.
whenToUse: Compare two supplied states with the same subject registration and scale.
avoid: Unmatched viewpoints, invented changes, or a wipe that misleadingly implies causal evidence.

parameters.description: Final revealed fraction; keep between 0.3 and 0.7.

requiredImages.role: Approved changed state, aligned to baseline.

choreography.reveal: 0–0.20: baseline is visible without a fade.
choreography.action: 0.20–0.65: boundary moves to expose the changed state.
choreography.hold: 0.65–0.92: both states remain visible and aligned.
choreography.exit: 0.92–1: marker recedes, image states stay for a cut.

adaptation: Use two actually approved image files; align their content before claiming a comparison.
Use animation-skills/machinal-motion and machinal-visual-review; inspect both sides at the hold.
Source-level design settings are not edit_scene_parameters fields. Test both portrait and landscape.

label: Schematic route journey
description: A traveler follows a two-segment route, activates three stops in causal order and settles at the destination. Explicitly schematic, not geographic evidence.
whenToUse: Explain a supplied ordered route or delivery path.
avoid: Using these arbitrary coordinates as a real geographic map or inventing places.

parameters.description: Supplied short heading; identify schematic status where needed.

choreography.action: 0.20–0.70: traveler follows segments and stops activate on arrival.
choreography.exit: 0.94–1: destination holds for an intentional cut.

adaptation: For real maps use approved cartography and verified coordinates; replace both path and traveler geometry together.
Adapt labels/point placement for actual content. Do not claim sampled states prove smooth travel.

label: Causal piston pump cycle
description: Schematic piston displacement expands then contracts a chamber while separate inlet/outlet valves gate the corresponding flow. A readable final hold, not a spinning primitive.
whenToUse: Explain a schematic positive-displacement pump cycle without claiming measured engineering accuracy.
avoid: Replacing a specific verified product's geometry or implying quantitative fluid simulation.

choreography.reveal: 0–0.18: chamber, piston and closed valves establish the mechanism.
choreography.action: 0.18–0.44: intake expands chamber; 0.49–0.75: discharge contracts chamber with the other valve open.
choreography.exit: 0.94–1: retain the complete mechanism for a cut.

adaptation: Keep valve timing coupled to piston direction; adapt actual geometry, not just the title.
Use machinal-choreography and inspect both intake and discharge, not only the final state.
Source-level design settings are not an exposed runtime parameter surface.
